## 2025-02-13 - Keyboard Accessible SVG Charts
**Learning:** Raw SVG `<svg role="img">` charts that handle mouse hover events natively don't offer keyboard accessibility out-of-the-box. The tooltip interactivity must be retrofitted for keyboard users.
**Action:** Change the chart container to `role="group"` (with an `aria-label`). For interactive hotspots (like `.hit` rectangles), add `tabindex="0"` and an `aria-label` generated by stripping HTML from the tooltip content. Finally, bind `focus` and `blur` events (using the element's bounding rect center to fake mouse coordinates) and style `:focus-visible` with an outline so keyboard focus is visible.
